Zero frequency is accepted unless a positive min_phrase_weight is configured.
TextDb::Update uses data_[key]=value, so later duplicate essay rows overwrite earlier weights.
Only collected entries become table entries. Valid zero weights are preserved using DBL_EPSILON.

input_identity.device_hash_limitation: No separate hash of deployed shared files was captured. Attribution combines logged paths, matching bundled/source bytes, exact 70803 entry / 424 syllable counts and exact 193-phrase failure-set equality.

static_model.method: Parse dictionary codes, vocabulary weights and 5% filtering, then model ScriptEncoder reachability. Every learned word is one Unicode character and each retains a reading; therefore a non-explicit essay term fails iff length>32 or any character is unmapped.

validity.zero_frequency_is_valid: PresetVocabulary keeps zero at the default minimum. DictCompiler uses DBL_EPSILON for valid zero weights. Missing phonetic mappings do not imply invalid Unicode.
validity.duplicate_note: Three unrelated duplicate keys exist. TextDb retains the last weight; none is one of193 rejected spellings.
